evidence.decision: Decides whether sensing adds meaningful fitness or gameplay value; rejects motion-dependent ordinary navigation and defines sensing only during the relevant activity.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a sensing lifecycle and action mapping, or a corrected ordinary-control alternative when motion has no useful task role.
evidence.transformation: The recipe example removes tilt-to-change-step and launch-time permission gating, retaining normal controls and making any beneficial sensing optional at its point of use.
evidence.verification: Checks motion-required routine UI, blocked progress after optional permission denial and sensing that outlives its activity, while leaving accuracy, battery and latency for actual devices.
evidence.applicability: Distinguishes Core Motion scope on iOS/iPadOS/watchOS from remote gyro context and avoids claiming unsupported Mac/visionOS app capability or invented calibration thresholds.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Privacy for the minimal permission purpose, Game Controls for gameplay mapping and Accessibility for a complete alternative.
evidence.distinctiveness: The meaningful-sensing decision, lifecycle stop/start contract and nonmotion path make this a sensor-specific redesign procedure rather than a catalog of device capabilities.
